plugin.note: Dogs (guard dogs, jackals, wild dogs) have no defensive bonuses, so any melee weapon works. Jackals additionally have a 10% elemental weakness to fire spells for a Magic alternative. Guard dogs in McGrubor's Wood are the most convenient standard spawn.

requirements: Combat level 15 is required to be assigned Dogs.
Membership is required for every dog spawn.
mechanics: Guard dog: combat level 44, 49 Hitpoints, max hit 5 (crush), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 37 with no bonuses.
Jackal: combat level 21, 27 Hitpoints, max hit 3, Defence level 15; 10% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Wild dog: combat level 63, 62 Hitpoints, max hit 6, Defence level 54 with no bonuses.
None of the dogs are undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill guard dogs in McGrubor's Wood (or jackals/wild dogs) with any melee weapon; none have defensive bonuses.
steps: Travel to McGrubor's Wood for the densest guard dog cluster (10 spawns).
Attack with any melee weapon; weapon choice is unimportant given the zero defensive bonuses.
Alternatively kill wild dogs in Brimhaven Dungeon or jackals in the Kharidian Desert.
notes: Wild dogs in Brimhaven Dungeon are higher level (63) but give more Slayer XP per kill.

methods.label: Fire spells on jackals
methods.summary: Cast fire spells on jackals to exploit their 10% elemental weakness to fire.
requiredOrKeyItems: Fire spell runes or a fire-attuned staff
steps: Travel to the jackals south of the Ancient Pyramid (fairy ring DLQ north of Nardah).
Cast fire spells to exploit the 10% elemental weakness.
Keep antidrain and food as needed.
notes: Only jackals carry the fire weakness; guard dogs and wild dogs have no elemental weakness.
